comment: Golden bench characters for the bot leveling eval bench (docs/BOT_LEVELING_DESIGN.md). Donors are existing server-created bot characters copied (read-only) from a source characters DB into a bench DB and morphed: quest/social/group state wiped, level/money/position/homebind set from here, gear/spells completed at spawn by bot runtime morphing (GiveLevel + spell learning), as existing bot AIs already do.
